title: Robin For Good
style: Hyper-speed heist rap with jittery drum-programmed bounce, chopped sirens, and tense stop-start groove; verse rides tight Vietnamese rap phrasing over clipped bass and snare snaps, pre-chorus compresses into gang shouts and rising chatter, chorus slams with repeated English hook licks and doubled ad-libs. Vocal is gritty close-mic, fast-rapped in verses, shouted stacks on hook, with delay throws on key English phrases. Ear candy: siren swells, radio static flickers, reversed bells, and a hard drop into half-time before the final lift. Bright, punchy, cinematic mix with aggressive low end., bounce, rock, fake
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Maths driver, delta alpha
Tôi vào plan, không chờ
Hyper speed, I can
You got this, we believe

Mansion fake, bẻ khóa nhanh
Chase and cage, free birds rock
Unit 336, nghe chưa
Sirens sound, rồi biến mất

Heres my boys, thrash this toy
Take the right lane, no delay
Phonky sneaky, thrift drift
Kick cho họ rage trong cage

VDS Mansion, no way back
We go now, stay to escape
Math Driver, the architect
The dream done, safe done sound

[Pre-Chorus]
Chatter lên, đèn xanh lóa
Math Driver, say the word
Delta track, D J Zyn Rose
Pedals everywhere, we run

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah robin for good!

Cash back drop, what a shock
Chase and cage, free birds rock
A robin in hood
But it’s for good!

Bust ’em like we should
Ha bro, if we could!
You heard the sarg?
Chase and cage!

[Verse 2]
Sand box city, mắt đầy cát
Where are my toys? nhìn đâu
A bored stare, like we care
Ground hog day, same old sound

But I forget what eight is for
Math driver, kéo tôi đi
VDS Mansion! We go now!
Hyperspeed, no more sleep

Thrash this toy, G4
Hyper speed plane, over head
Police chatter, sirens sound
But my feet don’t miss a step

Extra stripe for no rage
A robin out of the mansion
Fake a break, rồi cắt ngang
Catch that boy, then vanish

[Bridge]
Sand box city, sand box city
VDS mansion, party for me
Sand box city, sand box city
Math Driver, one more key

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah robin for good!

Cash back drop, what a shock
Chase and cage, free birds rock
A robin in hood
But it’s for good!

Bust ’em like we should
Ha bro, if we could!
You heard the sarg?
Chase and cage!
